integrity_notes: Self-contained proof plus reproducing finite tests, with bibliographic comparison against identified published general algorithms. No independent validation or claim of comprehensive worldwide priority.
scientific_limitations: Only the pair of ternary permutation powers (012)^r and (021)^s, all positive r,s; distinct words rather than positional embeddings. Does not solve general maximal-common-subsequence enumeration, and an unindexed equivalent is possible.
title: A binomial maximal-common-subsequence law for two ternary permutation powers
